scope: Executable communication component design/source gate, not independent implementation review
inspected_primary_passages: RFC9112 sections2.2,3.2.2,5,6.3,7.1 and9; existing curriculum contract supplies bounded policy choices
RFC9293 sequence variables, receive acceptability, ACK/SND.WL1/SND.WL2 and state processing
RFC6298 sections2–5: weighted update order, lower/cap bounds, Karn sampling and timer management
reflection: Keep OS socket ownership separate from original packet-stack ownership.
Use the same HTTP core through explicit adapters.
A mock register response is not controller loopback or wire success.
Expose unfinished physical and cumulative integration mechanisms in every relevant manifest scope.
limits: Partial anchors, not full T38–T42 reference solutions
No actual MCU peripheral or physical link execution
No general Internet-host/TCP/HTTP production security certification
